title: Derived plan v1
description: GET /api/products/{slug}/plan: the product laid out by core's layout, flat, with every tile's health per enabled lens. Levels are wing, room, bay, tile (the web's words). A node names its parent by id, never by reference. Boxes are world units. Derived from the map, never stored.

rev.description: The fingerprint the structure route answers for the same map and events.

lenses.description: The enabled lens ids in registry order: the keys of every tile's health.

planWing.description: A wing: Kettle's five groups of domains; any other product has one wing per domain.

order.description: Position left to right, oldest work first.

letter.description: A, B, C in chronological order.

planRoom.description: A room: a domain in Kettle; a capability in any other product (its parent wing is the capability's domain).

planBay.description: A bay: a capability in Kettle; in any other product the room's features of one kind (user_flow, capability, ops, integration, or generic for any other kind), in that order, with id <capability id>.<kind>.

order.description: Position within the bay, oldest first.

health.description: Each enabled lens's reading, by lens id.

general.description: General health: the worst of the enabled lenses.
